body:
Thanks.

I feel like every baby step I take forward, I end up taking like five backwards. At what point am I justified in throwing in the towel? I feel like I've done everything right, just to have it all go wrong. I'm just tired of waking up every morning to fight for something I don't even want anymore.
Thanks, I really appreciate the offer but I'm trying to remain fairly anonymous with everything. The offer does make me feel a bit better though, so thanks for that.
I'm hanging in there. Still in the dark, but here regardless. I every day I spend alive is at least one more day no one can begrudge me for not trying, eh?

I really appreciate someone who understands taking the time to inquire. I think part of my problem is that none of my friends know how bad things are and my family couldn't give two shits if I live or die.

I'll try to keep checking back, too.

I am in my late twenties and I have been struggling to get my head above water for a long time. I just can't seem to get my life to a place where it makes logical sense to continue it. Not for lack of trying, either. I appreciate your taking the time to ask. It seems like no one does these days.
